Military and Special unlockLevels copied from Multiplayer's in-game screens (16 Oct 2026; weapon level is shared). Special challenges read off DMZ's own camo screens (video, 20 Oct 2026). Mastery images are real; tier 2/3 challenges in game: 'Get &&2 Tier 3+ enemy kills and then successfully exfil &&1 times', 'Get &&2 1 shot headshot enemy kills with max level operators and then successfully exfil &&1 times'. DMZ Mastery 2 (Ripple Tide) and 3 (Helio) from @brokealx on 17 Oct 2026, with a clip: these replace the recording's placeholder wording (Tier 3+ kills then exfil; one-shot headshots on max-level operators then exfil), which the game appears to have changed.
